_comment: Expected sheet_numbers were found by grepping build/words/*.json (lines rebuilt from block/line keys) with a regex per query, NOT by running search.py. A query passes when ANY expected sheet_number appears in the top-3 distinct sheet numbers. Evidence strings are the grep hits (sheet id, sheet number, matching line text).

queries.evidence: grep 'WC-|water closet': P101 (add1-p018/dwg-p034) 10 lines 'WC-1','WC-2'; grep '105A': P101 contains '105A' and the WC-1/WC-2/WC-3 tags sit within ~30-70 pt of the 105A room tag (words file coordinates) but on different text lines. A1100 only has WC-1 in a finish schedule; P001 has the fixture schedule but no 105A.

grep 'grab bar': A800 'GRAB BAR - 36"', 'GRAB BAR - 42"', 'GRAB BAR - 18" VERTICAL' (+ 'MOUNTING HEIGHT TO ...' soap dispenser line); G001 (dwg-p002) '18" VERT. GRAB BAR', 'TYPICAL ADA TOILET ROOM MOUNTING HEIGHTS', 29 AFF/height lines.

grep 'hardware|door schedule': A1002 (dwg-p024) 11 lines e.g. 'PER DOOR HARDWARE SCHEDULE', '11. ALL DOOR HARDWARE SHALL BE ADA COMPLAINT, INCLUDING LEVER'; E200 'COORDINATE ALL ELECTRIFIED DOOR HARDWARE, POWER TRANSFER DEVICES' ; E500 'LINE VOLTAGE POWER FOR DOOR HARDWARE POWER SUPPLIES'.
grep 'keynote': only add1-p008 (A203) has the line 'ROOF PLAN KEYNOTES'; A201 has 'PLAN KEYNOTES', A301 'RCP KEYNOTE'.

grep 'warehouse|\b151\b': ED200 (add2-p009) has WAREHOUSE and 151 lines; grep 'fire alarm': ED200 'EXISTING FIRE ALARM DEVICES WITHIN THE ADJACENT WAREHOUSE SPACES AND'; E200 '...DEVICES AND (16) OF NOTIFICATION APPLIANCES WITHIN THE WAREHOUSE AND'; AD201 has WAREHOUSE + 151.

grep 'cubb|alternate': A900 13 lines '8 TOTAL CUBBIES','12 TOTAL CUBBIES'; A1100 7 lines 'CUBBIES: PL-1 - SSM-1 CAP ON PARTIAL HEIGHT WALL'; A700 'FIXED PLAM CUBBIES,' 'STORAGE CUBBIE MILLWORK'. (The word 'cubby' itself never appears; sheets use CUBBIES/CUBBIE.)
grep 'keynote': A800 (dwg-p020/add1-p012) and A900 (dwg-p021/add1-p013) both have the line 'TOILET ACCESSORIES KEYNOTES'.
grep 'knox': A201 (add1-p007, dwg-p013) 'KNOX BOX RECESS MOUNTED 6'-0" AFF CENTERED ON WALL AS APPROVED BY FIRE MARSHALL.'; G001 only '(KNOX BOX)' legend entry.
grep 'mounting height|A.F.F': E400 (add1-p022/dwg-p052) line '2. MOUNT RECEPTACLE AT 36" AFF.'; E200 only has '44"AFF' device heights.
grep 'snow': only dwg-p029 (S900) has the line 'ROOF SNOW LOADS:' (S900 is not superseded).
